2023_027_may_2023_pcard_report.paragraph: Monthly purchasing-card (PCARD) transaction listing for the Troy School District covering the May 2023 billing cycle, carried in the July 18, 2023 Board of Education agenda materials. The 32-page schedule, printed 7/13/2023, itemizes each card charge by transaction date and merchant, with the journal-entry description MAY PCARD EXP, the charged budget unit, the account code, and separate columns for transaction amount and credits; posted transaction dates run from 4/26/2023 through 5/25/2023. The listing closes with a subtotal of 315,601.31 in charges, 11,157.14 in credits, and Total Expenses of 304,444.17.
